work.title: AI Engineer
bullets: Developing **Plinth**, an agentic AI platform that turns 2D architectural and structural drawing PDFs into complete 3D BIM models in Autodesk Revit.
Designing a **LangGraph**-based multi-agent pipeline where vision-language models read drawings and extract building components, and agents build the full model in Revit through **MCP**.
Earlier (part-time), built a chat assistant that lets users interact with BIM models in Autodesk Revit.
